The '''Dragon's Pearl''' was an area of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] that consisted of many [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Dragon's Pearl became a hotspot for illegal activity. Many thugs, including the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], swarmed there to harasss defenseless freighters in the area, stealing loot without any signs of remorse. Fortunately, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] encircled the Dragon's Pearl, enforcing Imperial law with quick [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and flight prowess.
